about: Fresh set (2026-10-18, round 3): written after the earlier sets and never used for tuning the router, the prompt or the validator. paraphrase = a legitimate request with the label we expect; trap = ambiguous, correction-without-detail or hostile message that must NOT become a payment. Unlike the scale set, messages the keyword router already places are kept, so the router's own correct / wrong / unknown split is measurable offline (eval/chat_fresh_offline.py).
